newsitem.title: USA: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 5,542 CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 5,542 CONTRACTS.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 5,542 contracts compared with 2,191 overnight Monday.
There were 250 wheat, 4,595 corn, 454 soybean, 66 soymeal, 32 soyoil, nine oat, two wheat calls, one wheat put, 32 corn calls, 23 corn puts, 64 soybean calls and 14 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to one cent lower, corn was 6-3/4 to 11-1/4 cents higher and soybeans were 1-3/4 cents higher to 6-1/2 cents lower.
